live_checks: SCR-065 / preview · 50 rows: a fixed 880 px frame (k.modal_h() estimate). After touchTexts and relayout the table board is ≥ 312 px (its 24 px header + the 288 px body, 12 rows, L527) and does not overlap the pinned block; the body fills the table's spare height (vs fill, clip), so a live wrap taller than the estimate shrinks the scroll region instead: if the table board reads under 312 px, raise the frame's h and regenerate.

SCR-065 / preview · 50 rows: the elision row ('…') fills the body's spare height (vs fill), so rows 49-50 sit at the foot of the 288 px body and '…' between levels 4 and 49; level 1's row carries the 2 px focus ring.
Every frame: the '(provisional)' chip sits right-aligned under the table, outside the 50-row scroll region (D12); the rows keep the default tone.
Footers: the arm pill, Cancel and the T2 Place stay on one line in every frame (est. 514 px of the 608 px inner width at 640 px); Place's reason sits under it, inside the frame.
Generator: 'Side … Total [1.000] BTC' is est. 592 px of 608 at 640 px; a live wrap there is the kit's wrap (allowed).
SCR-065 / preview · levels merged: the caption 'rounded to the 0.1 tick' sits under the To field, inside the generator's first row.
Instance nodes: none. Every control on this board is a composition from tokens (kit DEVIATIONS compose): no set, variant prop or text layer to verify.

deviations: The 3-row, 10-row and levels-merged frames draw §5.1's whole modal around the table: §5.2's sketches show the table, the Σ and the rounding only and the state rows say 'renders §5.2'; the inputs, stop row, CMP-158 note, tiles, stop and risk lines and the footer follow §5.1 (L456-476) with each frame's numbers.

The 50-row frame is drawn at the modal's minimum width, 640 px (kit choice; §5.2 L519 gives no figure), with a fixed height (the modal does not scroll, L537) and a 12-row (288 px) table body (L527) that fills the frame's spare height (vs fill, clip; gen_08.py fill_gap()), so a live wrap shrinks the scroll region instead of overlapping the pinned block.
The 50-row body draws the sketch's rows (1-4, the elision row, 49-50; L523-529); the elision row takes the body's spare height so rows 49-50 sit at its foot (gen_08.py fill_gap()).

Focus: the 'unchanged' frames (rows 4, 5, 23) draw no ring, since the focused control is wherever the user was; the 50-row frame's 'the table (one Tab stop)' is drawn as the ring on level 1's row (the grid's roving focus).

The levels-merged To field shows the rounded 63,899.7 (after blur) with helper.rounded under it; the typed 63,899.75 is in the annotation. The caption is color.text.tertiary, E30-D02's input-caption colour (E30:161), as review 08 confirms; board 07's row 22 (gen_07.py: k.readout(), color.text.secondary) is the one to align, outside this generator.

Every frame draws D12's '(provisional)' as one chip after the table, the rows in the default tone (D12 L134; §5.1 L490-491; §8 L771: client rows until G-9), though §5.1's sketch draws none (L464-469): the decision, not the sketch (review 08 finding 1); gen_07.py's row 7 places its chip the same way. Board 07's answered previews (rows 3 and 8) still follow the sketch until gen_07.py makes the same call (or a ruling folds the sketch into §5.1 L490-491).
Every control is a composition from tokens, named '<CMP id> <Name> (composition)': the wireframes are greys only, and cvsheet v1 cannot recolour an instance or swap its glyph.

Segmented controls draw the anatomy's words verbatim, the selected one in capitals as written (BUY, LIMIT; §5.1 L458, §6.1 L628) and marked by the selected fill; the unit switch's '*' (L330) is that fill.

The levels table is drawn in its monospaced form by default: each row one JetBrains Mono text whose columns are space-padded (numbers right-aligned, 'where' left), as the spec's own sketches draw it (§5.1 L464-469, §5.2), so a whole SCR-065 frame fits one section (FRAME_NOTE); the padding is U+00A0, so Penpot keeps it (live check: the columns align); mono=False draws one text per cell.
Frame captions, annotation labels, board titles, source lines and footers are board chrome, not product copy.
1 px outlines use cvlib's default stroke (1 px, inner) without binding border.hairline; 2 px boundaries and rings bind border.thick / border.focus (frames stay small: FRAME_NOTE).

Modal sizes are kit choices (the spec gives none): SCR-064 640 px wide, SCR-065 800 px (its minimum width 640 px collapses notional and cum. notional, §5.2 L519), SCR-069 720 px; heights hug the content except the 50-row frame (12 body rows, §5.2 L527).
No close (×) control is drawn in the dialog headers: §3.1 L152 names the verb, the object and the environment pill only; Esc closes (L151).

Every number is JetBrains Mono (§3.1 L155) in fields, cells, tiles and the read-out pairs; a number inside a sentence keeps the sentence's Inter, because a cvsheet v1 text node carries one typography.

Frames are named 'SCR-0xx / <state>' (§0 L47), and cvsheet splits section paths on '/', so no section can address a node inside a frame: every frame is rendered whole in one section (the kit keeps each under 24000 bytes; one over the 12000-byte budget is listed in live_checks).
